component.name: Dayly - Time Tracker
component.summary: Local-only time tracker that lives in your tray

description.p: Dayly tracks working hours from the system tray. Start the timer when you begin, pause it when you stop, and see the day's total without opening a window.
Everything stays on this machine in a single SQLite file. There is no account to create, no cloud to sync with, and no telemetry — Dayly opens no network sockets at all.

ul.li: Start, pause and resume from the tray, with the day's total always visible
Idle detection that asks what to do with time away from the machine
Automatic pause when the machine sleeps or locks
A daily target, with progress shown against it
History by day, week and month, with segments you can correct after the fact
Export to CSV or JSON, and a one-file backup you can copy anywhere
An optional always-on-top mini window for a glanceable total

screenshot.caption: The tray panel, showing today's total and progress against the daily target
History by month, with per-day segments that can be corrected
Settings: appearance, daily target and idle detection
